name: Hookdeck activation 1
request: Write exactly one English activation email from the Hookdeck team. Reader: A developer with a new Hookdeck workspace and a test webhook source. Ask them to do one thing: Inspect a first incoming test event. Use a specific, documented first step and explain why it helps this reader. Keep the email under 150 words excluding subject, preview and signature. Avoid unsupported access, plan, timing and outcome claims. Use one CTA with an exact documented destination if available. Use this exact CTA destination: https://dashboard.hookdeck.com/signup?context=event-gateway.
target_market: A developer with a new Hookdeck workspace and a test webhook source.
